name: Rookie Oval
description: A wide, flowing loop with gentle slopes: learn the car and carry speed through the sweepers.

name: Hairpin Valley
description: Climb three switchbacks, cross the ridge and drop down two more: brake early, power out.

name: Ramp Rally
description: Four kicker jumps from 4 to 7 m: hit each ramp straight and land on the long run-outs.

name: Banked Speedway
description: Steep banked bowls hold the car at full speed: trust the banking and stay flat out.

name: Technical Trial
description: Narrow chicanes, a jump, banked sweepers and a switchback climb: rhythm beats top speed.

name: Grand Marathon
description: Over 6 km point to point: jumps, switchbacks, banked bowls and narrow chicanes in one run.

name: Coastal GP
description: A fast grand-prix circuit at sunset: big braking zones, quick esses and a narrow final sector.

name: Mountain Pass
description: A 4.5 km sprint over the pass: banked switchbacks up to the summit and a fast, twisting descent.

name: Canyon Run
description: Out and back through narrow red-rock badlands with jumps, blind crests and tight S-bends: the hardest circuit.

name: Night Highway
description: Kilometre-long straights under the lights: brake hard for the slow corners and fire the nitro out of them.

name: Lighthouse Bay
description: Long sweeping bends round the bay, past the lighthouse: throw the car sideways and hold the drift.

name: Seaside Stunts
description: Six kickers down the coast road, with step-downs and a 7.5 m launch: line up straight and fly far.

name: Forest Rally
description: A dirt rally stage through the autumn woods: flowing bends to slide through, crests and a jump.

name: Northern Lights
description: Packed snow under the aurora: banked snow bowls, a jump and long slides. Smooth hands win here.

name: Summit Rush
description: The finale over the mountain: asphalt, a dirt forest climb, snow on the summit and a flying descent.

name: Pine Ridge
description: A fast gravel stage through the pine forest: flowing bends, blind crests and two jumps.

name: Dune Sea
description: Soft sand over the dunes: long slides, a flat-out dry lake bed and a jump off a dune.

name: Frozen Lake
description: Bare ice out on the lake and packed snow along the shore: brake early and steer with the throttle.

name: Monsoon Trail
description: A narrow jungle track in the rains: deep mud, switchbacks up a gravel climb and a drop off the ridge.

name: Monaco
description: The real harbour street circuit: walls on both sides, the Casino climb, the tightest hairpin, the quayside.

name: Silverstone
description: The real airfield circuit: fast sweepers through Maggotts and Becketts, two long straights and the Loop.

name: Spielberg
description: The real Austrian circuit on a Styrian hillside: a long climb to a tight hairpin, then fast sweepers down.

name: Le Mans
description: The 24-hour circuit: a 6 km straight through the woods with two chicanes, Mulsanne and Arnage.
